title: The Shortest War in History Lasted 38 Minutes

scenes.text: The shortest war in history lasted 38 minutes.
In 1896, the ruler of Zanzibar died, and his cousin took the throne without Britain's approval.
Britain gave him an ultimatum: step down by nine in the morning.
He refused. At two minutes past nine, British warships opened fire on the palace.
By twenty to ten the palace was burning, the sultan had fled, and the war was over.
Thirty-eight minutes. Some people take longer to choose a movie.

description:
The Anglo-Zanzibar War of 27 August 1896 began at 9:02 and was over by about 9:40.
It's the shortest war ever recorded.
What's the strangest war you've heard of?
